arms.rationale: Sim's fixed appeal proxy (quick, short, brief) — a no-taste, no-learning surface.
Sim's seeded uniform random reference — the sanity floor for every other arm.
The current rule ranker as built on alpha, ported faithfully — the bar the activation gate names.
Explicit profile edits only (restrictions, never-suggest, stated prefs), no behavioral learning — the second activation bar.
Family 1: Sam's Beta posteriors per evidence source and feature, reliability-weighted — the trust-vector design applied to taste.
Part 1's TasteEngine as built: Bayesian linear-Gaussian posterior, Thompson sampling, exposure weighting, recency half-lives, cold-start blend — the activation-gate subject.
Family 3: L2-regularized logistic regression on cooked/saved/skipped evidence, shrunk toward a rule-aligned prior.
Family 4: pairwise learning-to-rank (RankNet gradient on within-session chosen-vs-shown pairs).
Family 5: linear features plus a per-recipe 8-dim embedding scored against a learned household vector.
Family-2 with exposureFloor = 1.0: behavioral evidence keeps full weight no matter how forced the choice was — isolates the exposure-weighting contribution.
Family-2 with all evidence half-lives at 10^9 days: no posterior forgetting — isolates the recency/drift-handling contribution.
Family-2 ranked greedily (explore: false): no Thompson draws — isolates what deliberate variety buys.

note: suite-B campaign, staged weekly replay, checkpointed per (seed, arm)
